n: AI plus Ethics for Middle School
t: An open middle school curriculum on how AI works and what it means for society.
steps: Find the AI plus Ethics for Middle School curriculum and open the materials document.
Check the license, which allows use but forbids derivatives.
Print the bingo cards, worksheets, cat and dog cards, and instrument packs.
Gather butcher paper and prepare the slides.
Book Chromebooks with webcams for the classifier, Speculative Fiction, and YouTube activities.
Test the internet connection on those Chromebooks.
Start with AI Bingo and move through the eight activities in order.
